scope: Bounded batch6: Select/ComboBox/CommandPalette existing public consumers and shared filtered-menu dismissal; not complete component/page maturity
baseline: All current WIP, including later uncommitted behavior; frozen AgentKit package untouched

root_causes.defect: FilteredMenu/ComboBox/CommandPalette ordinary activation/dismissal used cancel, discarding OverlayPresence; live filtered mapping could erase outgoing labels after selection changed query.
root_causes.fix: crates/tekes-ui-controls/src/layout_view.rs: reuse existing dismiss, source mapping and OverlayPresence; explicit cancellation still clears.

root_causes.defect: Existing consumers used needs_animation rather than presentation state, missing pending exit paint; filtered semantic parts and AX actions used visible positions rather than original source positions.
root_causes.fix: examples/composition-consumer/src/choice_status.rs, combo_status.rs, command_status.rs; SelectView::is_presented and Scenario forwarding reuse existing presence.

root_causes.defect: Select and ComboBox put failure feedback below the trigger, where the option overlay covered it.
root_causes.fix: Reuse existing Stack ordering, as CommandPalette already does: feedback before query/trigger.

exceptions: Original source-position indices are stable through filtering, not permanent business keys across arbitrary source replacement.
Changed source invalidates outgoing mapping; window unavailability and explicit cancel hard-clear retained paint.
Existing closed OverlayPresence invalidates resource/geometry changes; Select label changes may resize the trigger and cancel exit. Unchanged-geometry exits are separately proved.
ComboBox remains a valid editable text surface after popup close; closed CommandPalette revokes its hidden editor.
No new abstraction layer, token, state machine or UI framework. No migration of unrelated component families.

GPU.dimensions: 3 existing consumers x 4 themes x 3 brands x 2 width/scale pairs x 2 type scales
GPU.reference: Only old consumer composition with current shared primitives; not an old whole-library binary. Old exit paint appears in some reference cases; recorded rather than forced to fail.

native.kind: tool-driven real AppKit keyboard/AX, status/reorder commands, real minify/deactivation/reactivation

bounded_checks: Failure remains readable while cached options stay open.

Window deactivation revokes overlay/focus; actual reactivation restores fresh interactions in exercised paths.
